name: Bounded System-One exact-request single-flight
logic_name: Decision sharing keyed by full request and authenticated worker model identity

test_list.description: Concurrent identical requests produce one inference item and return the same validated decision.
Dropping the owner wakes a follower, which retries and returns a fresh worker result.
The in-flight state transitions to retry after owner cancellation.
A timed-out waiter leaves the still-active owner available to complete.
Different worker incarnations or request bytes elect separate owners.
The registry bypasses flight coordination when its 32-key limit is reached.
The registry bypasses coordination once 32 waiters are already admitted.
A process incarnation change produces a distinct cache identity.

inputs.name: model_identity_and_request
inputs.description: Exact request bytes and fresh worker digest, generation, and process incarnation.

output_description: Owner, bounded waiter, or bypass role; only successful stable-identity results are shared.
